description: This file contains implementations of tensor reshaping functions for Metal backend in PyTorch, including 'view', 'reshape', 'flatten_using_ints', and 'detach'. It manages tensor metadata, GPU texture allocations, and command buffer encoding for Metal and MPS (Metal Performance Shaders). It also registers these functions with the PyTorch library via the TORCH_LIBRARY_IMPL macro.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Creates a reshaped tensor view for Metal backend using Metal APIs and command buffer encoding.

methods.name: reshape
methods.description: Reshapes the input tensor into specified shape, leveraging the 'view' function.

methods.name: flatten_using_ints
methods.description: Flattens a specified range of dimensions into a single dimension, handling special cases like zero-dimensional and identical start and end dims.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Returns the input tensor as-is for Metal backend, acting as a detach operation.
